method: Visual review of rendered original pages 1-4,7,10-12; pages8-9 directly extracted text; pages5-6 collected only.
scope: Recurring civil office operating requirements; no detailed trial-setting or motion-specific litigation analysis.
date_note: Printed Date on page1; no separate effective date established. Filename is not used as revision/effective evidence.

conflicts.issue: Page10 states materials at least2business days before hearing; page11 says uploads completed1business day before hearing. Preserved without selecting one.
Page10 says no mailed hard copies unless JA specifically directs; page11 permits mailed hard-copy fallback if OneDrive impossible. Preserve both qualifications; no reconciliation.

operating_qualifications: In-person default for matters not yet set as of effective date of update; remote appearance requires motion and permission; no separate effective date supplied.
Hearing request email JA copying opposing counsel; confirmation before notice; central time; pro se coordination/no-response exception; added motions require JA/opponent clearance.
Conferral exceptions include truly dispositive motions, emergency inability to contact, posttrial/postjudgment; curable technical dismissal issues treated separately.
OneDrive route; prior filed-document exception, no emailed hearing materials, small-claims bring-to-court/provide-other-party exception.
Cancellation email JA; court-ordered hearing requires court approval; contingent settlement language must be agreed before removal request.
